title: Music Player for Android
meta_description: Music player & Audio player, powerful Equalizer, Bass boost, Sound changer!
full_description: Quick search all music files, HD playback, Powerful equalizer, free to get this perfect audio player and media player.This music player is not only based on artists or albums, but also based on the folder structure. And more than 3 desktop widgets make your music play never been so easy.Over 22 gorgeous background skins to make your music player look more outstanding,The unique equalizer make your music sounds like you've never had before.Key Features:- Browse and play your music by albums, artists, genres, songs, playlists, and album artists.- 3 simple home screen WIDGETS (4x1,2x2,4x1).- High quality decoding with mp3,mp4/m4a,wma,flac and ape;- Smart Playlists for easy access to your favorite and Most Played songs.- Find all your music files never been so easy.- search the online hot music videos- Auto search relative music video/MV- cut/edit Music file, free make ringtone files- Remember last playlist- Lyric support.- Five band equalizer.- More then 20 types of pre-set music tone for your choice, or you can manually adjust the equalizer.- Manually pick your preferred album artwork, artist pictures, genre illustrations from the Internet, the Gallery app, ID3 tags, or album folder.- home screen WIDGETS- NOTIFICATION STATUS support: display album artwork, title and artist, play/pause, skip forward and stop CONTROLS in notification status.One of the most successful and high quality music players for Android.Please know before download: This app just a  local music player, we do not provide online music search and download.
